speed.notes: 20 feet, burrow 45 feet, climb 20 feet; earth glide;

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.text: The shaitan can Burrow through dirt and stone at its full burrow Speed, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing.

traits.name: Shove into Stone
traits.text: (arcane, earth, transmutation); When the shaitan Pushes a creature into a stone barrier, the target must succeed at a DC 22 Reflex save or become merged with the barrier (as meld with stone). The victim can attempt to Escape (DC 28).

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ falchion +20 (forceful +1, magical, reach 10 feet, sweep); Damage 1d10+12 (1d10+12) slashing

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ fist +19 (agile, magical, nonlethal, reach 10 feet); Damage 1d4+12 (1d4+12) bludgeoning plus Push 10 feet and shove into stone
